newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Exchange suspends Baloise trade.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Exchange suspends Baloise trade.

text.p: The Swiss Exchange suspended trade on insurer Baloise ahead of a statement and news conference on future strategy set for 0945 GMT.
"The company will announce important news during this trading day," the bourse said in a statement after suspending Baloise shares before the day's business began.
Trade in Baloise would resume at 1300 GMT, a bourse spokesman added.
Baloise closed on Monday at 2,875 Swiss francs per registered share, up by 1.6 percent on speculative buying ahead of Tuesday's news conference.
